title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: Just as Ye Qing's voice abruptly stopped, a pitch-black eye suddenly tore open in the void—the projection of the Heavenly Eye, and it was gazing at him.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently beneath Chen Ji's fingertips. The erased name's remnant traces actually glowed with an eerie dark red light—as if blood sealed for ten thousand years was awakening. Chen Ji felt a burning heat in his chest, and an unfamiliar yet familiar force spread through his limbs along his bloodline—that was... resonant homology? His pupils constricted sharply as he looked up to see Ye Qing's figure slowly emerging from the depths of the mist. That enchanting face actually bore two streams of clear tears.

「Chen Ji... you finally discovered it.」 Ye Qing's voice was hoarse and weary. Those purple eyes no longer held their usual sharpness; instead, there was a despairing resignation. 「Did you think I chose to cooperate with you because of that so-called prophecy?」 She gave a bitter smile. 「How naive. From the beginning to the end, I was a piece arranged by others—just like you.」 Her fingertip pressed against her heart. 「This heart is the cause planted by that person from ten thousand years ago. Holy Sect Saint? Merely a vessel for breeding.」

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji slowly withdrew his hand from the fragment, a cold smile curling at his lips) 「A piece? Ye Qing, do you take me for a three-year-old? If you truly had no choice, how do you explain the blood debts on your hands during those years at the Holy Sect?」 His tone was terrifyingly calm, each word like a poisoned needle. 「However... since you dare come see me, you must have some reason you can't help but say. Go on, what price did the Heavenly Eye offer you to stage this ruse?」

text.content: At Ye Qing's words, her body shuddered violently. She didn't rebut. Slowly, she loosened her outer robe's collar, revealing a ferocious black pattern beneath her collarbone—that pattern writhed like a living thing, occasionally revealing a closed eye motif. 「This is the Myriad Spirit Lock.」 Her voice was very soft. 「From the day the Holy Sect took me in, they carved this thing on my heart. Once I harbor rebellious thoughts, or say something I shouldn't—it will... tear my heart apart.」

dialogue.content: 「And now it's about to mature.」 Ye Qing re-covered herself with her garment. A flash of resolve flickered in her purple eyes. 「The Heavenly Eye needs a契机—an opportunity to break the balance of fate. It chose you, Chen Ji. Chose the inheritor of the Tianji Record as the sacrifice for its return to the mortal realm. And I... am the blade responsible for leading you to that node.」 She gave a bitter smile. 「How laughable. The Demonic Path Saint, following nothing but the curse carved into our very bones and blood.」

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, yet his eyes showed no sympathy whatsoever. He stepped forward slowly, each step measured with practiced precision—that was a distance he'd calculated a thousand times. 「So what?」 His voice was light. 「You came to see me today, wanting me to help you break this Myriad Spirit Lock, or trying to persuade me to乖乖 become that sacrifice?」 He stopped three feet before Ye Qing. The air between them seemed to freeze into ice. 「Ye Qing, neither of us is a fool. If you truly wanted to betray the Heavenly Eye, you wouldn't expose yourself this way.」

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled again. A message directly poured into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—it was the voice of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, ancient and urgent: 「Chen Ji, be careful! This woman not only has the Myriad Spirit Lock but also a trace of the Heavenly Eye's will! It's observing you through her eyes!」 Immediately after, Chen Ji felt the burning in his chest grow even more intense, as if an invisible chain was extending from the depths of his bloodline, trying to bind him to some distant existence.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's gaze flashed, though his expression remained calm) 「Interesting.」 A mocking arc curled at his lips. 「I thought the Demonic Path Saint came to submit,没想到 was here to be an eye.」 He suddenly raised his hand. A strand of spiritual energy precisely struck Ye Qing's Brow Center, where skin a closed eye pattern also appeared beneath. 「Although Chen mou doesn't like meddling in others' affairs, being treated as a monkey... has its price.」

text.content: Ye Qing didn't dodge. She let his spiritual energy seal that acupoint. She closed her eyes, letting tears fall, yet her voice grew calm instead: 「You want to kill me, I won't flee. But before you act, there's something you must know—your sister Chen Nian, she's alive. Not just alive...」 She opened her eyes,直视 Chen Ji's gaze. 「She was taken by the Heavenly Eye to the Convergence Point of Fate, as... the key to start the final chess game. The Myriad Spirit Lock told me, that moment is near. In three days.」

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. A surge of killing intent exploded from him—that was an anger even he hadn't sensed before—not directed at Ye Qing, but at the so-called Heavenly Dao. His bloodline seemed to sense something. The burning in his chest suddenly transformed into a blazing white light, forming an eerie confrontation with the black patterns on Ye Qing's body. Blood Resonance... Twin Fates of Destiny... The bond between him and Chen Nian had been exploited by the Heavenly Dao to such an extent!

「Three days...」 Chen Ji's voice was dangerously low, each word seeming to be挤出 from between his teeth. 「Are you telling me my sister's life is also a piece on your chessboard?」 He pressed closer to Ye Qing. The two were near enough to feel each other's breath. 「Ye Qing, I'm giving you one chance. Now tell me, which side are you really on?」 His eyes held no anger, only cold scrutiny. 「Think carefully before answering. My patience... is limited.」

choice.prompt: A struggle flickered in Ye Qing's eyes. She knew this choice would determine her fate—whether to continue being controlled as a piece, or to gamble everything on resistance.

choices.description: Temporarily believe Ye Qing's claims, include her in his own chess game, and use her to turn the tables. The risk is being stabbed in the back, but the gain is using her Myriad Spirit Lock and Heavenly Eye trace to gather intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Gain access to Ye Qing's intelligence line, possibly turn the tables on the Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may be possessed by the Heavenly Eye at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji stared into Ye Qing's eyes for three breaths, then suddenly withdrew his spiritual energy. A meaningful smile curled at his lips: 「Interesting. The Myriad Spirit Lock... might be more useful than you think.」 His finger lightly tapped Ye Qing's collarbone, where the black pattern slightly trembled. 「Since the Heavenly Dao wants to use you as an eye, I'll let it see all it wants. In three days, I will appear at the Convergence Point of Fate. Whether you want to be a blade or a shield by then—your choice.」

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing froze. She hadn't expected this answer from Chen Ji) 「You... trust me that easily?」 Her voice trembled. 「I just tried to lead you into a deadly trap as a piece.」 Chen Ji coldly laughed: 「You? No. The thing controlling you—that is.」 He turned away, back facing her. 「I, Chen Ji, never trust anyone, but I'm skilled at using everything. Including the shackles on your body.」

choices.description: Give Ye Qing no more chances, consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate to forcefully activate all predictive abilities of the Tianji Record, and annihilate the Heavenly Eye's will on her. The cost is enormous consumption of Heavenly Fate, and forever losing Ye Qing's intelligence line.
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate the threat of Heavenly Eye's will on Ye Qing, gain freedom of action
choices.risk_hint: May accidentally injure Ye Qing, and lose future intelligence sources

text.content: Chen Ji spoke no more. He raised his hand and pointed at Ye Qing's heart. The Tianji Record Fragment dramatically unfolded. A force containing the Laws of Fate instantly pierced through the space between them. 「I told you,」 his voice was icy as cold wind from the Nine Netherworlds. 「I, Chen Ji, bear grudges but never act rashly. Since the Heavenly Dao wants to scheme against me through you, let it see... what it means to lose one's shirt trying to steal a chicken.」 That finger directly pierced the Myriad Spirit Lock's barrier, forcibly stripping out the Heavenly Eye's will within!

Ye Qing let out a shrill scream. The black patterns on her body twisted violently. The closed eye motif suddenly opened wide—its pupil actually reflected an even larger vertical pupil, cold, emotionless, transcending mortal existence. However, in the next moment, that vertical pupil was forcibly erased by the Tianji Record's power, leaving only a roar seeming to come from the depths of the void. The Myriad Spirit Lock... was broken.

choices.description: Let go of hostility toward Ye Qing, use his own Heavenly Fate to share her Myriad Spirit Lock's erosion, and establish a true alliance with her. This is the most risky choice, but may unlock the 'Shared Fate' prototype effect.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 points of Heavenly Fate to share Ye Qing's Myriad Spirit Lock
choices.visible_reward: Establish a deep bond with Ye Qing, unlock 'Shared Fate' prototype, able to share some abilities afterward
choices.risk_hint: Massive Heavenly Fate consumption may temporarily weaken one's predictive abilities

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing and suddenly laughed—that smile held no mockery, no coldness, but a nearly compassionate serenity. 「We're both pieces,」 he said softly. 「Manipulated by that lofty thing for all these years.」 He extended his hand, pressing it on the Myriad Spirit Lock above Ye Qing's heart. 「Since it wants to use us as sacrifices, let it see... what happens when pieces awaken and flip the chessboard.」

He slowly infused his Heavenly Fate into Ye Qing's body. The black Myriad Spirit Lock pattern began to tremble, crack, and peel away—at the same time, Chen Ji felt a segment of his lifespan seem to be drawn away. But he didn't release his hand, because he sensed—in the depths of Blood Resonance, his sister Chen Nian's position was becoming clearer. Heavenly Eye, you've been setting pieces for ten thousand years, so what? This game, I, Chen Ji, accept!

Just then, a cold mechanical voice suddenly sounded simultaneously in both their Mental Seas—the voice of the Heavenly Eye, ancient, desolate, carrying not a shred of emotion: 「Interesting. Inheritor of the Tianji Record, you chose to defy fate? Then... let me see how long you can last.」 Before the words finished, a pitch-black rift suddenly opened in the void. Within the rift depths slowly opened a giant eye. Its pupil reflected the figures of Chen Ji and Ye Qing—and the outline of a young girl suspended by chains in the endless void. Chen Nian!

Chen Ji's fists tightly clenched, his knuckles white from force. His sister... imprisoned in such a place, unseen by the sun for ten thousand years, merely to serve as the key for the Heavenly Dao's return. Surging flames of fury burned in his chest, yet his expression grew ever calmer—that was the stillness before a storm, the composure of a hunter before pulling the trigger. 「Ye Qing,」 his voice was very soft, yet carried unwavering resolve. 「Tell me the location of the Convergence Point of Fate.」

Ye Qing wiped away her tears. A trace of determination appeared in her purple eyes: 「The eastern sea's shore, the Rift Ruins. At the hour of midnight three days from now, a Gate of Fate will open there—at that time the Heavenly Eye's true form will briefly descend, and Chen Nian is the key to that gate.」 She paused, then took out a pitch-black token from her bosom. 「This is the Holy Sect's passage token. With it, you can enter the ruins' core.」 She placed the token in Chen Ji's hand. 「I owe you a life. Now... I'm beginning to repay it.」

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji took the token, his fingertips gently stroking the patterns on its surface, a cold smile curling at his lips) 「Owe a life? Ye Qing, you underestimate Chen Ji too much.」 He tucked the token into his sleeve, then shifted topics. 「I don't want your life. I want your... rebellious spirit. In three days, you'll come with me. Not as a piece, but as—」 He stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes, each word deliberate. 「—my ally.」

text.content: Blood Resonance reached its peak at this moment. Chen Ji clearly sensed his sister Chen Nian's location—a bond transcending time and space, as if the umbilical cord between them had never been severed. And deep within that perception, he also detected a strange fluctuation: a pair of eyes was peering through the Gate of Fate at all this—the Heavenly Eye's true form—it gazed at this piece on the chessboard attempting to rebel with an almost amused expression.

「Very well.」 Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice not loud, yet clearly transmitted into the perception of every existence. 「Ten thousand years, Heavenly Eye. You've set pieces for ten thousand years, manipulated how many cycles of fate, crushed how many geniuses as pieces beneath your heel...」 He slowly raised his head, directly facing that giant eye in the void's rift. 「Today, I, Chen Ji, stand right here. You want to use my sister as a key? Fine. You want to use me as a sacrifice? Also fine. But you'd better pray... that when the chessboard flips, you can still sit steady.」

The giant eye in the void slightly narrowed. In its pupil reflected Chen Ji's figure. An invisible pressure like a mountain crashed down. Ye Qing staggered, nearly falling to her knees, but was caught by Chen Ji. His spine stood perfectly straight, as if that pressure was merely a gentle breeze. 「Three days, the eastern sea's shore.」 Chen Ji released Ye Qing, turning to walk into the depths of the mist. 「Before then, I still have some pieces to place.」 His silhouette gradually dissolved into the darkness, leaving only a softly spoken sentence. 「Ye Qing, next time we meet... bring all the cards you can play.」
